name: El Nino forecast (ENSO models)
description: Nino 3.4 from OISST with the WOD thermocline (warm-water volume) and ERA5 wind stress: the ENSO library's baselines (persistence, climatology, AR), recharge and delayed oscillators and the linear inverse model (quick settings), tuned on 1982-2011 and scored on the untouched test period from 2012 against climatology and persistence. Left out of this example for run time on a shared 4-core CPU: the intermediate coupled model (im_nudged, over 55 minutes without finishing) and gradient boosting (gbm, over 18 minutes); both are in the node's model list.
